stem.text: What is the name of the instrument visible on the right side of the image?

feedback.text: Correct. This is the dissector (Maryland dissector), a blunt-tipped instrument used to gently separate tissue planes without electrical energy.
Incorrect. The hook has a distinctive curved metal tip and delivers monopolar electrical energy for cutting and coagulation. The instrument shown has a blunt grasping tip.
Incorrect. The clip applier has a bulkier jaw mechanism designed to deploy surgical clips. The instrument shown is a slender blunt dissector.
Incorrect. Scissors have paired cutting blades. The instrument shown has blunt grasping jaws for tissue separation.
